frametrail:attributes.text: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong style="font-size: 12px;">A FILM ABOUT FRAMETRAIL, MADE WITH FRAMETRAIL</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 14px; color: #494C51;">Press play. Sound on.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 60px;">This is not a video.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 22px;">No video file is playing.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px;">That progress bar is real. Drag it.</span></p>

<p><span data-ft-no-split="" style="font-size: 34px;">It is a timeline.</span></p><p><span data-ft-no-split="" style="font-size: 34px;">Everything on it is </span><span style="font-size: 34px;">data.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 46px;">And the player is the editor.</span></p>
